recognize_zh: 骨髓切片上方有一顆巨核細胞，細胞質內含四到五個彼此分離的圓形核，背景為高細胞性、紅血球與顆粒球系前驅細胞混雜並散在含鐵血黃素，提示巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Megakaryocyte with four to five widely separated round nuclei in abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei, some in clusters
Maturing granulocytes including band and segmented neutrophils
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow between adipocytes with trilineage hematopoiesis, including clusters of erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes. A megakaryocyte with four to five widely separated round nuclei is present, representing a dysplastic multinucleated form. Hemosiderin deposits are scattered, and no blast aggregates are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts lie along bone trabeculae with many uniform nuclei and a nucleolus in each, rather than within the intertrabecular marrow.
Reactive megakaryocytes have connected lobulated nuclei rather than discrete separated nuclei.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered, enlarged and hyperlobated or hyperchromatic rather than multinucleated with separate round nuclei.
